attorneys.name: Corey Adams
attorneys.practice_type: Business Lawyers in Wichita, KS
attorneys.bio:
Corey's practice is primarily focused in the areas of insurance, employment, business, real estate, and general civil litigation. He has significant trial and general litigation experience, representing a range of clients from business owners in contract and governance disputes, employers and employees in employment related matters, insurance companies in representing their insured clients in a wide range of personal injury and property contamination matters, and contractors in construction related disputes.

In addition to his litigation experience, Corey also provides advice and counsel to businesses and employers in a wide range of business-related issues, from the initial formation of companies to general advice and structuring of forward-looking operational agreements, policies, and compliance issues. He is an advocate for the entrepreneur, working alongside them to help them steer clear of common legal pitfalls. He also regularly advises management on employment related matters, including policy structures, employment contracts, regulatory matters, and organizational issues.

Corey grew up in Wichita. He is a graduate of Friends University where he received his bachelor's degree in English, and a graduate of the University of Kansas where he received his Juris Doctorate. When he is not working, he can normally be found with his wife and three young children engaging in the multitude of family activities throughout Wichita.

attorneys.name: L. Sheryl Adams Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Wichita, KS
attorneys.bio:
Going through a divorce in Wichita, Kansas can be a challenging and emotional experience. It’s not uncommon to feel uncertain or overwhelmed as your case progresses. Having supportive legal representation can help you navigate each step with greater confidence and clarity. L. Sheryl Adams serves as a Senior Associate Attorney at Stange Law Firm and represents individuals from the firm’s Wichita, Kansas office, assisting clients in Sedgwick County and nearby areas.

Sheryl attended Southern Methodist University School of Law, where she obtained her Juris Doctorate. Prior to law school, Sheryl completed her undergraduate studies at the University of Texas at Austin. Sheryl is licensed to practice law in Kansas and Texas.

Before becoming a Senior Associate Attorney with the Wichita family law and divorce attorneys at Stange Law Firm, Sheryl spent six months working as a Law Clerk for the firm. Before joining Stange Law Firm, she most recently served as an Associate Judge for the Collin County Probate Court, a role she held since 2011. In this position, she presided over involuntary mental health commitment filings and hearings, often during off-hours and with minimal supervision. She also worked closely with hospital staff and law enforcement personnel, offering guidance on mental health procedures, and frequently speaks to public and private groups to educate them on the mental health legal process. In addition to her judicial role, Sheryl maintained a legal practice since 1993, representing clients in criminal, juvenile, and probate matters. Her work included handling jury and bench trials, mental health proceedings, competency hearings, and contested motions. She is committed to seeking rehabilitative and supportive alternatives for clients when appropriate, including programs such as Drug Court, Veterans Court, and mental health treatment services. Sheryl has also gained experience in condemnation and Child Protective Services cases and has acted as an Ad Litem in matters involving adoption, custody, personal injury, and guardianship, advocating for the protection of individual rights throughout.

Note: The choice of a lawyer is an important decision and should not be based solely upon advertisements.

attorneys.bio:
Rian F. Ankerholz is a principal partner in the law firm of Ankerholz and Smith. Mr. Ankerholz has practiced law since 1982 when he moved to Overland Park from his birthplace of Lyons, Kansas. A second generation lawyer, Mr. Ankerholz grew up with an understanding of how various legal situations affect people's lives. He received both his undergraduate degree and his law school degree from the University of Kansas. In order to serve the needs of the firm's clients in and around the Greater Kansas City Metropolitan area, Mr. Ankerholz was also admitted to the Missouri bar in 1995.

Mr. Ankerholz practices primarily in the area of civil litigation. Mr. Ankerholz handles divorce cases and family law matters in Kansas only. He emphasizes the needs and best interests of children in all types of family law cases, including divorce, child custody and paternity matters.

Mr. Ankerholz's wife, Nancy, is a homemaker. They have two daughters.

attorneys.name: John D. Beverlin II
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Litigation Lawyers in Pratt, KS
attorneys.bio:
With 20 years of legal experience, John developed an extensive practice focusing on civil and commercial litigation. He moved to south central Kansas in 2009 to join what was then Stull Law Office. John develops long-term client relationships across the state with his reputation for perfectionism, attention to detail, and curiosity.

John is an accomplished civil and commercial litigator, representing clients in all stages and areas of general litigation in both state and federal court. He has successfully navigated real property and property line disputes for his clients. John provides strategic and legal advice to several economic development corporations and municipal governments and has served as city attorney for several cities. John also represents several Kansas community development corporations.

He is admitted to the Kansas Bar, United States District Court for the District of Kansas, and the United States Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. John is a Kansas State University and Washburn University alumnus and spent three years in Topeka advising clients on the finer details of the legislative process and state policy.

Originally from the Kansas City area, he is an everything Kansas City baseball superfan. In fact, his youngest son’s name was inspired by one of the area’s historic baseball players, Leroy “Satchel” Paige. John and his wife, Tracey, attended law school together and share of love of Golden Retrievers and the outdoors. When not in the office, you can find John cheering one of his three children at a ball field or beside a wrestling mat.

attorneys.name: Caleb Biesterveld
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Overland Park, KS
attorneys.bio:
Caleb is a passionate trial attorney taking great pride in helping injury victims. His compassion is evidenced not only by his robust courtroom delivery but also by the way he genuinely listens to and cares for his clients. Caleb’s goal as a trial attorney is to make our community safer by holding individuals and corporations accountable for their dangerous conduct.

A zealous advocate for victims of dangerous conduct and consumer abuse.

Caleb represents injury victims, employees who have been discriminated against by their employer or harassed by a co-worker, and consumers who have been victimized by corporate fraud. Caleb has a knack for working with adversaries to negotiate a fair resolution of disputes. However, when the opposition is stubborn and unreasonable, he stands ready to fight for your rights and win your case at trial.

Biesterveld & Crook, LLC was formed in 2017 when Caleb partnered with his longtime friend Dustin Crook. Prior to joining forces with Dustin, Caleb owned and operated a solo law practice in downtown Olathe, Kansas.

Growing up on a small farm in southwest Missouri, Caleb learned the value of hard work at a young age. His work ethic helped Caleb graduate Valedictorian of his high school class. He then graduated magna cum laude from Missouri State University, earning a bachelor’s degree in Political Science with a minor in Psychology.

Caleb graduated with honors from Washburn University School of Law in Topeka, Kansas. While attending Washburn Law, he worked as a licensed legal intern at Washburn Law Civil Litigation Clinic, successfully representing clients in landlord/tenant disputes, estate planning, personal injury, employment discrimination, misrepresentation, fraud, collection, breach of contract, and negligence actions. He worked simultaneously as a Legal Intern for the Kansas Department of Wildlife, Parks, and Tourism where he drafted bills, legislative speeches, and State regulations.

Caleb is licensed to practice in both Kansas and Missouri State Courts, as well as the U.S. District Court for the District of Kansas and the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Missouri. He is a member of the Kansas Bar Association, the Missouri Association of Trial Attorneys, the Johnson County Bar Association, and the Washburn Alumni Association.

In his spare time, you can find Caleb in the great outdoors hunting, camping, fishing, and golfing. He also enjoys gardening, grilling, watching sports, and spending time with his wife and two young children.

attorneys.name: Lara Blake Bors
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Garden City, KS
attorneys.bio:
Children are a top priority for Lara and her practice shows it. Lara has taken her previous experience at the County Attorney's Office handling Child in Need of Care and juvenile offender cases to create a unique take on child custody proceedings. She served over ten years on the USD-457 Board of Education which helps her to put a child's education as a top priority before the Court in any child custody hearing. Lara serves in various capacities on local and state boards advocating for children which gives her a broad perspective of the resources available to her clients in not only child abuse or neglect cases, but her divorce and custody proceedings -- helping to give her clients a leg up.

Her time at the County Attorney's Office has also given her a tremendous background to help you when you find yourself in a situation of being charged with a criminal, traffic or DUI offense. Individuals whom she has formerly prosecuted have sought her assistance to have the person who worked so hard against them to now be working that hard for them.

After graduating from Washburn Law School in 2001, Lara moved to Garden City with her husband, Carl. She served as an Assistant County Attorney from 2001-2010. She went into private practice in 2010 and opened Bors Law in 2011. She and Carl have two sons. When she is not working hard representing her clients, Lara enjoys spending time with her boys and watching them play football, baseball, basketball and anything else they put their mind to which may also include putting a robot or two together.

Lara prides herself in her firm being a "user-friendly" firm. Her goal is to help take the burden off of you with regard to any of the issues that you may be dealing with.

attorneys.name: Matthew L. Bretz
attorneys.practice_type: Auto, Truck, and Motorcycle Accidents Lawyers in Hutchinson, KS
attorneys.bio:
The best way to get to know me and find out why I love being a trial lawyer at Bretz Injury Law is to understand where I come from. I grew up with a single mother and three sisters and spent a lot of time with my grandparents. An inquisitive kid, my mom, and grandparents pushed and challenged me, helping me develop a passion for learning. With their support, I got my first job at the age of 11, earned the rank of Eagle Scout by 13, and then graduated college and started teaching classical and quantum physics at Kansas State University by the age of 20.

One of the side jobs I did as a kid was yard work for a local retired lawyer. I didn’t know what lawyers did, but I admired this man and wanted to be like him. Physics and teaching intrigued me, but I could not get the idea of being a lawyer out of my mind.

I think there are three primary things that have made me who I am as a trial lawyer. The first was an opportunity to get out of Kansas and attend Pepperdine University School of Law in California on a scholarship. I didn’t realize the importance of it at the time, but I received an education from one of the top law schools in the country. For me – a small-town Kansas boy – this was an eye-opening and horizon-expanding experience.

The second career-defining opportunity was lucking into a job during law school with the Los Angeles firm of Erin Brockovich, Delta Force II, and The Twilight Zone fame, Engstrom Lipscomb & Lack. At Pepperdine I learned “the law,” but at EL&L I learned how to be a trial lawyer, litigating aviation and catastrophic injury cases from around the globe.

The third, and by far the most formative event in my life, occurred on Valentine’s Day in 1992. On that day my 16-year-old sister, Marlee, and two of her friends were delivering baskets of flowers when their car was struck by a train, instantly killing all three of the girls in the car. Going through that devastation with my family at the time and in the years since has given me a personal understanding of the crushing pain suffered by those who have lost a loved one. Since then, I have devoted both my professional and personal life to helping those who have been seriously injured or who have lost a loved one, and to make the community a safer and better place to live.

My professional and personal lives bleed together. I am on the National Board of Directors for MADD with the singular goal of bringing an end to the mayhem caused by drunk and drugged drivers. I also volunteer time with the United Way, Red Cross, Interfaith Housing, ABATE, and the Training and Evaluation Center of Hutchinson.

Even after 30 years, I still enjoy teaching. As a trial lawyer, I get to teach juries, insurance companies, and frequently even defense experts. To help other trial lawyers improve their skills and get better results for their clients, I teach trial lawyers across the country – from Seattle to Atlanta and every place in between – at the Keenan Trial Institute. I’ve also been able to teach through the local community college, the Boy Scouts, and Sunday School.

I handle motor vehicle, premises liability, dangerous and defective products, and nursing home cases. I’ve been fortunate to receive accolades from CNN, Martindale-Hubbell, and AVVO. But the recognition most dear to me was a handwritten note from a client saying: “You treat me like your only client, and I so appreciate that.”

My wife of 33 years, Amy, holds a Master’s Degree and is a Licensed Specialist Clinical Social Worker. She works part-time at United Way and volunteers around the community. We have two compassionate and driven daughters, Lauren and Hannah. Lauren’s undergraduate degree is from K-State. She also earned a Master’s degree in Speech and Language Pathology and completed her law degree in two years at the University of Kansas. She is now an associate at a Kansas City firm that handles class-action and multi-district litigation. Hannah’s undergraduate degree is also from K-State. After college she attended Brooklyn Law School. She is now a public defender in The Bronx, New York.

attorneys.name: Keith A. Brock
attorneys.practice_type: Oil & Gas Lawyers in Ottawa, KS
attorneys.bio:
After earning a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration from the University of Kansas in 2006 and graduating from Washburn University School of Law in 2009, Keith began practicing law in Franklin County. Keith joined the firm in 2007 as a law clerk and became an associate with the firm in 2009 and a partner in 2010.

Keith is admitted to practice before all courts in Kansas including the U.S. District Court for the District of Kansas.

Keith has chosen to focus his practice in the area of oil and gas law, commercial real property law and banking, primarily representing oil and gas producers, commercial real estate developers and lenders. He is experienced in title examination, transactional drafting, civil litigation, regulatory compliance and conservation practice before the Kansas Corporation Commission. Keith is a member of the Board of Directors for the Eastern Kansas Oil & Gas Association and is a member of the faculty for the Mineral Title Examination course and also the Oil and Gas Conservation Law & Practice course offered by Washburn University School of Law. He has also taught the Oil and Gas Law course at the University of Kansas School of Law as an adjunct professor. Keith has been a presenter at multiple continuing legal education seminars, typically presenting on the subject of oil and gas law and is the President of the Kansas Bar Association, Oil, Gas and Mineral Law section and is past president of the Franklin County Bar Association.

He has been selected to the "Super Lawyers for Kansas" each year since 2018. attorneys.name: Scott R. Brown
attorneys.practice_type: Intellectual Property Litigation Lawyers in Overland Park, KS
attorneys.bio:
Scott is a partner at Hovey Williams and is the head of the litigation department. He began his career in California's Silicon Valley in 1990. He moved to Kansas and joined Hovey Williams in 1999. His practice includes all aspects of intellectual property creation, management, enforcement, and licensing, with particular emphasis on intellectual property litigation. Scott has been a first chair trial lawyer since 1999, handling more than one hundred lawsuits in federal courts across the country. Scott has also been lead-counsel in numerous administrative actions before the Patent Trial and Appeals Board in inter partes review proceedings and has also appeared in post grant review proceedings and reexaminations. Scott has argued numerous times before the United States Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit, appealing and defending judgments from district courts and the PTAB.

Scott has handled a variety of intellectual property litigations, including patent, trademark, trade dress, copyright, unfair competition, and trade secret actions. He has significant expertise in patent infringement actions, representing plaintiffs and defendants in all aspects of such disputes. His experience includes a wide range of technologies, including digital and computer hardware, digital signal processing, software, agricultural implements, complex mechanical machines, medical devices, and chemical and biotechnology-based disputes. He has played a leading role in a variety of successful patent enforcement and licensing campaigns on behalf of the firm's clients.

Scott also advises clients on infringement, validity and patentability opinions, copyright, trademark and trade dress disputes, IP licensing, and other IP related business decisions.

Scott has been selected as a Fellow of the Litigation Counsel of America a national trial lawyer honorary society composed of less than one-half of one percent of American Lawyers.

attorneys.name: Aaron Bruns Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Topeka, KS
attorneys.bio:
Facing a divorce or other family law matter is never easy. Oftentimes this can be one of the hardest situations you’ve had to face in your life. When these situations arise, it is imperative that you have dedicated legal representation in your corner. Your attorney will be able to provide you with peace of mind and guidance throughout the process and you’ll be able to rest easy knowing that your case is in caring hands. Aaron Bruns is a Senior Associate Attorney with Stange Law Firm, PC. He can represent clients from the firm’s Topeka, Kansas office in Shawnee County.

Aaron attended the University of Oklahoma College of Law in Norman, Oklahoma where he obtained his Juris Doctor in May 2017. While in law school, he also served as a member of the Public Interest Law Student Association and the Organization for the Advancement of Women in Law. Before law school, Aaron earned his Bachelor of Arts in Philosophy from the University of Tulsa, where he was also a member of the Honor Society. Aaron is licensed to practice law in the state of Kansas.

Before joining the Topeka, Kansa divorce and family lawyers at Stange Law Firm, Aaron spent the past three years working as an Assistant County Attorney for the Seward County Attorney’s Office. While in this role, he worked on the prosecution of Traffic, Juvenile, Misdemeanor, and Felony matters, took part in bench and jury trials, and helped to prepare witnesses. Aaron also spent his first few years out of law school working as an Associate Attorney for various law firms in Oklahoma and Nebraska, allowing him to develop skills including legal research, discovery, document drafting and filing, caseload management, and trial preparation. Aaron also held many legal positions while in law school, providing him with a solid foundation for his legal career.

Note: The choice of a lawyer is an important decision and should not be based solely upon advertisements.

attorneys.name: Chadler E. Colgan
attorneys.practice_type: Business, Commercial and Personal Civil Litigation Lawyers in Kansas City, KS
attorneys.bio:
Chad has practiced in both large and mid-sized firms for over a decade specializing in business litigation, property rights and appeals with an expertise in research and writing. In 2017 he joined his parents at the Colgan Law Firm to bring those skills to businesses and individuals that need an aggressive litigation attorney who is a problem solver first and foremost. Not all lawsuits are alike and Chad is proficient at analyzing your case and determining the appropriate strategy to achieve the best results.

Chad has also practiced both family and criminal law and can offer those services in addition to business and personal civil litigation helping small business owners and individuals that are owed money or defending those claims when disputes arise. These types of cases need someone who will work out creative solutions and litigate in court when necessary. Chad's practice has also included extensive real estate litigation, title disputes, homeowner's association representation along with debtor's rights and consumer law cases. Chad's courtroom experience has included both civil and criminal jury trials along with numerous oral arguments in state district and appellate courts.

If you have any type of civil dispute or potential civil lawsuit he can assist with those matters in addition to all family and criminal law cases.

attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Olathe, KS
attorneys.bio:
Carl Cornwell has been practicing law for over 40 years, and currently focuses his practice exclusively on criminal defense. He has a wealth of criminal defense experience, having tried over 250 felony jury trials and over 50 homicide cases. Mr. Cornwell was admitted to practice in Kansas in 1977, and has also practiced in Missouri state courts. He has been listed in Super Lawyers magazine since 2005.

Mr. Cornwell's criminal defense expertise also extends to federal courts, as he has practiced extensively in a number of district courts throughout the United States, from Puerto Rico to Vermont to Washington. He received his Bachelor of Science degree from Kansas State University in 1970. After serving as First Lieutenant in the U.S. Marine Corps for three years, Mr. Cornwell earned his Juris Doctor from Washburn University School of Law in 1976.

attorneys.name: Tina L. Cox Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Guardian ad Litem Lawyers in Overland Park, KS
attorneys.bio:
Finding a family law attorney in Overland Park, Kansas is an extremely personal decision. They help you through some of your most trying times, touching on some of the most important aspects of your life. Tina Cox is an understanding and empathetic attorney who is used to helping families through these difficult times. Tina is a Partner who manages the West Region of the firm in Overland Park, Lee's Summit, Springfield (MO), Tulsa, Oklahoma City, Wichita, Topeka, and Kansas City (by appointment only).

Tina graduated with her undergraduate degree in Economics and Finance from Washburn University. She graduated Magna Cum Laude and a member of the Omicron Delta Epsilon International Economics Honor Society. She then went on to further her education and receive her Master's Degree in Business Administration as well as her Juris Doctor from the University of Kansas.

Prior to working at Stange Law Firm, Tina was a solo practitioner for 18 years. She practiced in the area of family and domestic violence law, providing her valuable insight into all aspects of your domestic case. She served as a parent's attorney as well as a guardian ad litem in both juvenile court and Child in Need of Care proceedings. Tina is also a trained Mediator.

Tina is also Lead Counsel Rated for Divorce Law since 2019, which is a quality assurance tool established in 1997. Attorneys are eligible to be Lead Counsel Rated after demonstrating significant experience, peer endorsements and a clean discipline history.

When Tina is not in the office, she enjoys spending time with her three children, traveling, playing sports and being outdoors.

attorneys.name: Dustin Crook
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Overland Park, KS
attorneys.bio:
Background

Born and raised in Lyon County, Kansas, Dustin brings small-town values and a strong work ethic to his practice. Dustin has a record of success obtaining real results for his clients.

Dustin started his own practice in 2015 after three years at a Topeka, Kansas law firm that focused on complex civil litigation and personal injury cases. In 2017, Dustin partnered with attorney Caleb Biesterveld to form Biesterveld & Crook, LLC.

Practice

Dustin is licensed to practice in both state and federal courts in Kansas and Missouri. He specializes in personal injury and wrongful death cases involving car accidents, slip and falls, and defective products. Dustin represents people suffering from an array of injuries, including brain and spine injuries, and his practice also includes complex real estate, business, and construction litigation.

Awards

Dustin was named a Super Lawyer’s “Rising Star“, a “Top Ten Attorney” by the National Association of Personal Injury Attorneys, and a “Top Car Accident Attorney” by Avvo.com. Dustin is a member of the Earl E. O’Conner American Inns of Court, the Missouri Association of Trial Attorneys, the Kansas Trial Lawyers Association, and the Johnson County Bar Association.

Dustin is also an Army combat veteran. He served in Iraq in 2004 where he provided security for military supply convoys and drove a 40-foot, 34-ton flatbed semitrailer delivering food, equipment, and ammunition to the front lines. Dustin was awarded the Army Commendation Medal for “Meritorious service in support of Operation Iraqi Freedom.”

When not advocating for his clients, Dustin enjoys reading and spending time with his wife and three young children.

Dustin represents people suffering from an array of injuries, including brain and spine injuries, and his practice also includes complex real estate, business, and construction litigation.

Awards

Dustin was named a Super Lawyer’s “Rising Star“, a “Top Ten Attorney” by the National Association of Personal Injury Attorneys, and a “Top Car Accident Attorney” by Avvo.com. Dustin is a member of the Earl E. O’Conner American Inns of Court, the Missouri Association of Trial Attorneys, the Kansas Trial Lawyers Association, and the Johnson County Bar Association.

Dustin is also an Army combat veteran. He served in Iraq in 2004 where he provided security for military supply convoys and drove a 40-foot, 34-ton flatbed semitrailer delivering food, equipment, and ammunition to the front lines. Dustin was awarded the Army Commendation Medal for “Meritorious service in support of Operation Iraqi Freedom.”

When not advocating for his clients, Dustin enjoys reading and spending time with his wife and three young children.

attorneys.name: Janet L. Damore
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Leawood, KS
attorneys.bio:
Janet L. Damore established her solo practice in October, 2007, and practices exclusively in the family law area. Janet earned both her undergraduate degree and juris doctor from the University of Kansas. Janet has a BV rating with Martindale-Hubbell Law Directory.

Before establishing her solo practice, Janet was co-founder and senior member of Schlagel Damore Gordon & Kinzer, LLC, in Olathe, Kansas, and had been with the firm since 1993.

Janet began her legal career with Kansas Legal Services where in addition to providing general legal services to lower-income clients, she served as Project Coordinator for the Domestic Violence Project and Project Coordinator for the Hospital Patient Assistant Project.

Janet is a seasoned family law attorney and has extensive litigation experience in matters involving marital dissolution, child custody, support, division of marital assets, and paternity. Her family law practice encompasses the Kansas City metropolitan area and surrounding counties in Kansas and Missouri.

Janet has been instrumental in introducing Collaborative Law to the Kansas legal community. She is a founding member of the Collaborative Law Institute of Kansas and served as its first President. She is also a practitioner member of the Collaborative Law Institute of Missouri. She has taught continuing legal education seminars on collaborative law, in addition to various other domestic law topics. Beyond her education and experience in the law and the collaborative law model, she has received training in basic mediation, Domestic Relations Mediation, and Domestic Case Management.

Throughout her career, Janet has participated in several activities of the organized bar. For many years she was a member of the Family Law Bench Bar Committee of the Johnson County Bar Association. She also served as President of the Johnson County Bar Family Law Section. She is an active member of the International Academy of Collaborative Professionals, as well as the Johnson County, Kansas, Missouri and American Bar Associations. Janet was formerly an Associate in the Kansas Inn of Court and most recently a Barrister of the Earl E. O'Conner Inn of Court.

Janet is committed to providing the highest quality of legal representation to her clients and she derives immense satisfaction from helping people through a very difficult chapter in their lives.

attorneys.name: Jeffrey F. Dasenbrock
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Paola, KS
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Jeff Dasenbrock grew up in Lawrence, Kansas, where his family still resides. After graduating from the University of Kansas with a B.A. in honors history, Jeff attended law school at the University of Houston Law Center. He remained in Texas to practice law for over three years before moving back to his home state of Kansas in 2009.

Jeff has a broad depth of legal experience in both civil and criminal law. Jeff began working as an attorney for Legal Aid of Northwest Texas in 2006, where he assisted clients in multiple areas of law, including but not limited to family law, civil litigation, estate planning (trusts, wills), employment law, consumer rights, unemployment/workers' compensation, SSD/SSI, landlord/tenant, worker's compensation, and more.

In 2008 Jeff began working as an Assistant Criminal District Attorney for the Wichita County District Attorney's Office, where he spearheaded the Gang Injunction Unit and helped run the Drug Enforcement Division. Jeff was also the City Prosecutor for Saint Joseph, Missouri, where he prosecuted criminal misdemeanors, traffic offenses and ordinance violations.

In 2010, Jeff joined Nicholson Law Office, LC, an established law firm founded by attorney Robert ("Bob") Nicholson, who had practiced law in Paola, Kansas for 40 years. In 2012, Jeff was promoted to Partner and the firm's name changed to Nicholson, Dasenbrock & Hartley, LC. During his tenure as Managing Partner at Nicholson, Dasenbrock & Hartley, LC, Jeff was in charge of handling family law, criminal defense, civil litigation, and auto accident injury cases. During this time, Jeff built lasting relationships and created a reputation in the legal community and among his clients for his hard work, honesty, trust, communication, and passionate advocacy.

In 2021, Jeff decided to start his own law firm, Dasenbrock Law, LLC, where he maintains the same qualities and characteristics which have made him one of the most respected attorneys in the legal community. At Dasenbrock Law, LLC, all clients are treated with dignity and respect. Jeff is honest and forthright with his clients, always making sure to tell them what they need to hear instead of what they want to hear. Jeff prides himself in being a trusted advocate with the integrity to always do what is in the best interest of the client.

Throughout the course of his career as an attorney, Jeff has personally tried multiple cases to verdict and therefore navigates the courtroom with ease. Jeff is currently licensed to practice law in two states: Kansas and Missouri. He is passionate about serving the needs of his clients and committed to supporting them every step of the way in their cases. Jeff sees every client as a human being, and not just a number. He has achieved outstanding results for his clients and will continue to do so in the future.

Awards and Honors

Kansas Top 10 Attorney Award for 2022 and 2024 - National Academy of Family Law Attorneys

attorneys.name: William P. Denning
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Overland Park, KS
attorneys.bio:
William is the founding member of Denning Law Firm, LLC. After spending over a decade as a partner at a well-known civil defense firm in the Kansas City area, William (or "Willie" as his friends and family refer to him) established Denning Law Firm with the purpose of using the knowledge and experience he gained representing insurance companies and their insureds for nearly fifteen years to now represent and prosecute cases on behalf of those that have been injured or wronged.

Willie's experience showed him that people who are injured by the negligence of others need someone with the legal knowledge and experience to help them through the process of obtaining the relief or remedy to which they are entitled. Working with insurance companies provided invaluable insight into how they evaluate, negotiate and defend claims against individuals who have been injured or experienced other catastrophic loss and damage. This knowledge allows Willie to level the playing field when negotiating and litigating against insurance companies.

When litigating against an insurance company, an attorney needs to be prepared, willing and able to try cases. Willie has successfully tried multiple cases to verdict in both federal and state court including trying several multi-million dollar cases. He has argued cases before the Kansas Supreme Court and the Court of Appeals in both Kansas and Missouri. He also is admitted to practice before the United States Supreme Court, 10th Circuit and 8th Circuit Court of Appeals.

Willie practices throughout Missouri and Kansas and primarily focuses on the areas of personal and catastrophic injury, motor vehicle accidents, product liability, trucking/transportation liability, premises liability (slip and fall) and medical/professional liability. Willie has been a recipient of the Super Lawyers designation. When Willie is not representing clients, he can be found spending time with his wife, Emily, his two daughters and their two dogs.

Michael C. Duma began his legal career as a criminal prosecutor in the Wyandotte County District Attorney's Office. At his time there, he developed a skill for litigation and held an impressive conviction record.

In 2013, Michael entered private practice with his father John Duma and began a focus on defending those accused of crimes. Since that time, Michael has distinguished himself as a leader in the field of criminal defense and DUI defense. Michael has been named a Super Lawyer "Rising Star" by Thompson Reuter's since 2015 and has been selected by the National Trial Lawyers Association for their "Top 40 under 40" designation since 2015. Michael regularly appears in state and federal courts across the metropolitan area and is well known for his skilled trial advocacy.

Michael believes the highest calling of a criminal defense attorney is to fight for someone that is wrongly accused, be with them through the process of being prosecuted, and walk out of the courtroom with them when a verdict of not guilty is returned.

attorneys.name: Thomas J. Erker
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Olathe, KS
attorneys.bio:
Thomas J. Erker is known as an aggressive, effective, and professional trial attorney who fights for his clients' interests through persistent advocacy in Kansas Courts. Tom has been trying criminal and civil cases since 1982, successfully defending and representing individuals facing criminal charges, driving under the influence, domestic relations cases, custody issues, juvenile charges, and personal injury and wrongful death cases. After starting his career as a Johnson County, Kansas Assistant District Attorney in 1982, Tom has been in private practice since 1985.

Tom's relentless hard work and well developed trial skills have benefited numerous clients facing serious criminal charges such as homicide and felony DUI. His extensive trial practice, especially in felony and DUI defense, is bolstered by the development of new defenses and strategies applied throughout every stage of a case to combat the efforts of State and City prosecutors.

Tom has lectured throughout Kansas on topics such as criminal and DUI defense, training other lawyers to defend those charged with serious criminal offenses. His unyielding pursuit of excellence has been recognized with the highest possible rating, AV*, from Martindale-Hubbell, an exclusive peer review rating system, reflecting the high esteem in which Tom is held throughout the legal community.

Tom's litigation style and willingness to try tough cases has served his many clients well in various practice areas. Tom enjoys working for those people who have placed their case in his hands with the confidence that he will work tirelessly to protect their interests in the midst of difficult times.

attorneys.name: James G. Flaherty
attorneys.practice_type: Public Utility Law Lawyers in Ottawa, KS
attorneys.bio:
Jim was born in Kansas City, Missouri in 1957. He received his undergraduate degree from Rockhurst College in 1979 and received his law degree from Washburn University School of Law in 1982. Jim was an Assistant General Counsel at the Kansas Corporation Commission from 1982-1985. He joined the firm in 1985 and became a partner in 1990. He is admitted to practice before all courts in Kansas, the U.S. District Court for the District of Kansas, and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit.

Jim is a partner in the firm, and he is a member of the Kansas Bar Association. He is past president of the Oil, Gas and Mineral Law Section of the Kansas Bar Association. He actively participates in the Kansas Independent Oil & Gas Association and is a member of its Natural Gas Committee. Jim is also involved in the Interstate Oil & Gas Compact Commission and Federal Energy Bar. He has authored several articles relating to the oil and gas and public utility industry. His primary fields of practice are oil and gas law and public utility law. He typically represents oil and gas producers, intrastate natural gas pipeline companies, natural gas local distribution companies and electric utility companies before the Kansas Corporation Commission. He has also represented clients in numerous arbitration cases relating to electric generation joint operating agreements, gas gathering agreements and utility acquisition cases.

He has been listed in The Best Lawyers in America's Energy Law section since 2005 and Super Lawyers in Energy and Natural Resources section since 2008.

Jim is a member of the Administrative Procedure Committee of the Kansas Judicial Council.

Jim and his wife, Gina, have four adult children and four grand-children.

attorneys.name: Lawrence D. Flick
attorneys.practice_type: Truck Accidents Lawyers in Overland Park, KS
attorneys.bio:
Truck Accident Attorney Lawrence Flick has practiced law for over 40 years. For more than 25 of those years, he has focused on truck accident cases in Kansas and Missouri. He built his practice around one goal. Hold unsafe trucking companies and commercial drivers accountable and fight for people who suffer serious harm in truck crashes.

When you hire him, you deal directly with your attorney. He prepares every case as if it will go to trial. He does not hand off files to junior staff. He studies the facts, gathers the records, and works closely with experts. His approach gives you clear communication, fast action on evidence, and a case built with care.

Truck crash cases involve specific rules and technical proof. Mr. Flick invests in training on federal trucking regulations, commercial driver safety, electronic logging data, black box downloads, and crash investigation. He stays current with trucking litigation groups and trial lawyer associations. These efforts support one purpose. Build strong cases that stand up in court.

He has recovered millions of dollars for injured clients. His work includes cases in state and federal courts, including appeals. One of his cases helped shape federal trucking law regarding leased equipment and company responsibility. Courts across the country have cited it.

Mr. Flick earned his law degree from the University of Kansas in 1982. Before that, he studied business and accounting. He is licensed in Kansas and Missouri and admitted to practice before several federal courts, including the Eighth and Tenth Circuit Courts of Appeals. He has completed federal commercial vehicle safety and crash investigation courses.

attorneys.name: John Gibson
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Litigation Lawyers in Wichita, KS
attorneys.bio:
John represents healthcare and commercial liability insurance clients in civil litigation matters. He also represents clients in business and corporate matters as well as estate planning and administration, including wills, trusts, powers of attorney, transfer-on-death deeds, guardianships, prenuptial agreements, blended family planning and a broad range of estate planning options. Small business ownership is often closely tied to family estate planning and his practice includes incorporation, business buy-outs, asset transfer agreements and business succession planning.

He received a Bachelor of Science degree in Business Administration from Newman University and graduated from Washburn University School of Law in 1972. He served as associate editor of the Washburn Law Journal.

Admitted to practice in 1972, John joined the former Boyer, Donaldson & Stewart firm, which merged with Gilliland & Hayes, LLC in 2002. He is admitted to practice before the Supreme Court of Kansas, the United States District Court for Kansas, the Tenth Circuit Court of Appeals, and the U.S. Supreme Court. John is a founding member of Gibson Watson Marino LLC.

In addition to his professional memberships, John is a member of the Wichita Executives Association, on the AAA of Kansas Traffic Safety Board of Directors, and serves at the Christian Legal Society Legal Aid Clinic.

attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Leawood, KS
attorneys.bio:
KIRK J. GOZA

Mr. Goza is a founding partner of Goza & Honnold, LLC. Prior to starting Goza & Honnold, LLC, he spent eight years as a partner at a nationally recognized products liability firm and for three years was head of the firm's Tort Section. Before that, he spent fifteen years at a major Kansas City firm where he was a director and a member of their Hiring, Associates and Executive Committees.

Mr. Goza has over 25 years experience trying lawsuits and managing significant pieces of litigation including class action claims of consumer fraud, antitrust violations, pharmaceutical and other mass tort product liability, toxic torts, professional negligence claims and general business litigation. During his career, he has represented both plaintiffs and defendants and has represented some of the largest corporations in America in jurisdictions around the country. His primary focus now is representing plaintiffs in personal injury and mass tort claims. Mr. Goza also works extensively as a mediator and has fulfilled the training requirements set out in Missouri Supreme Court Rule 17.

In 1993, by recommendation of Missouri Judges, Mr. Goza received the Lon O. Hocker award as one of the three outstanding young trial lawyers in the state. Ten years later, in 2003, he was inducted as a Fellow in the American College of Trial Lawyers . In March of 2009 he was inducted into the International Society of Barristers. Mr. Goza is a member of the American Board of Trial Advocates and served five years on the Board of Directors of the Western Missouri/Eastern Kansas chapter of that organization, and was President of the chapter in 2003. He was Board Certified as a trial advocate by the National Board of Trial Advocacy ( Missouri has no approved certification process.) and was recently re-certified. He has been listed on numerous occasions in the Best Lawyers in America, Missouri and Kansas Super Lawyers, and Kansas City 's Best of the Bar. He is a frequent writer and lecturer on the topics of trial practice and technique.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
KIRK J. GOZA

Mr. Goza is a founding partner of Goza & Honnold, LLC. Prior to starting Goza & Honnold, LLC, he spent eight years as a partner at a nationally recognized products liability firm and for three years was head of the firm's Tort Section. Before that, he spent fifteen years at a major Kansas City firm where he was a director and a member of their Hiring, Associates and Executive Committees.

Mr. Goza has over 25 years experience trying lawsuits and managing significant pieces of litigation including class action claims of consumer fraud, antitrust violations, pharmaceutical and other mass tort product liability, toxic torts, professional negligence claims and general business litigation. During his career, he has represented both plaintiffs and defendants and has represented some of the largest corporations in America in jurisdictions around the country. His primary focus now is representing plaintiffs in personal injury and mass tort claims. Mr. Goza also works extensively as a mediator and has fulfilled the training requirements set out in Missouri Supreme Court Rule 17.

In 1993, by recommendation of Missouri Judges, Mr. Goza received the Lon O. Hocker award as one of the three outstanding young trial lawyers in the state. Ten years later, in 2003, he was inducted as a Fellow in the American College of Trial Lawyers . In March of 2009 he was inducted into the International Society of Barristers. Mr. Goza is a member of the American Board of Trial Advocates and served five years on the Board of Directors of the Western Missouri/Eastern Kansas chapter of that organization, and was President of the chapter in 2003. He was Board Certified as a trial advocate by the National Board of Trial Advocacy ( Missouri has no approved certification process.) and was recently re-certified. He has been listed on numerous occasions in the Best Lawyers in America, Missouri and Kansas Super Lawyers, and Kansas City 's Best of the Bar. He is a frequent writer and lecturer on the topics of trial practice and technique.

attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Overland Park, KS
attorneys.bio:
The Grover Law Firm, LLC, offers clients the best of both worlds - He is an Attorney with extensive legal expertise, knowledge and experience combined with the personal attention and focus that only a small, hardworking firm can provide.

Areas of Expertise

Attorney Mark Grover specializes in traffic and DUI/DWI defense, Personal Injury litigation and criminal defense. He also supports small business clients with expert legal counsel and direction in the areas of business formation, contracts, disputes and other litigation issues.

Experience

With more than 12 years of experience practicing law in a large, multi-state law firm and in the legal departments of two Fortune 500 companies. He earned a Juris Doctor from the University of Arkansas at Little Rock School of Law, a B.A. in Political Science from Fort Hays State University and is admitted to practice law in Kansas, Missouri and the United States District Court for the District of Kansas. He serves as Legal Counsel for Student Legal Services at the University of Kansas Medical Center and is a graduate of the National College of DUI Defense conducted at Harvard Law School.

He is active in the Kansas City community and is a Big Brother with Big Brother Big Sister of Kansas City's Kaufman Mentor program. He served for seven years as a corporate United Way Ambassador and supports several local charities including Harvester's, United Way and BBBC of Greater Kansas City in their annual fundraising efforts. Mark is a member of the Kansas Bar Association, the Missouri Bar Association, the National College of DUI Defense and the Kansas City Metropolitan Bar Association.

attorneys.name: Scott C. Gyllenborg
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Overland Park, KS
attorneys.bio:
Scott Gyllenborg is a distinguished attorney with a career spanning decades in the legal profession. He currently serves as President of the Kansas City Metropolitan Bar Association (KCMBA), representing 5,000 members across a nine-county region. Scott is also a past president of the Johnson County Bar Association (JCBA), which includes 1,700 members.

Throughout his career, Scott has held numerous leadership roles, including serving eleven terms as Chairman of the Criminal Law Section of the JCBA and as a board member of the Johnson County Bar Foundation. He is past President of the Kansas City Metropolitan Bar Foundation. Scott has also chaired the Herbert W. Walton Annual Bench/Bar Conference and served as Chairman of the Kansas Bar Association Annual Meeting/Joint Judicial Conference in 2012.

Scott is an active member of several professional organizations, including the National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, the American Bar Association (ABA), the Kansas Bar Association, the Missouri Bar, and KCMBA. He is also a Master of the Inn of the Earl E. O'Connor American Inn of Court, where he has served as a director. Additionally, Scott is qualified by the United States District Court for the District of Kansas to represent accused persons under the federal Criminal Justice Act.

Scott is admitted to practice before the Supreme Court of the United States, the United States Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit, the United States District Court for the District of Kansas, and the United States District Court for the Western District of Missouri. Recognized for his expertise, Scott has been selected to the Super Lawyers list every year since 2005 in Criminal Defense and DUI/DWI, an honor earned by only 5% of attorneys in Kansas and Missouri.

Scott’s dedication extends to academia. From 2007 to 2013, he taught Trial Advocacy to second and third-year law students at the University of Kansas School of Law. He is also a frequent speaker at continuing legal education (CLE) courses on criminal law and procedure.

Beyond his legal practice, Scott has made significant contributions to his community. He has served as a trustee, strategic planning chair, and alumni leader for The Barstow School in Kansas City, Missouri, his alma mater. Scott has also been involved with the Jayhawks for Higher Education Committee, the Leawood Chamber of Commerce, the Olathe Arts Alliance, and the Olathe Region United Way.

From 1994 to 2001, Scott was the weekly on-air legal analyst for FOX 4 TV in Kansas City, Missouri, beginning with the high-profile O.J. Simpson trial.

Scott resides with his wife and four children in Leawood, Kansas.

He is also a Master of the Inn of the Earl E. O'Connor American Inn of Court, where he has served as a director. Additionally, Scott is qualified by the United States District Court for the District of Kansas to represent accused persons under the federal Criminal Justice Act.

Scott is admitted to practice before the Supreme Court of the United States, the United States Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit, the United States District Court for the District of Kansas, and the United States District Court for the Western District of Missouri. Recognized for his expertise, Scott has been selected to the Super Lawyers list every year since 2005 in Criminal Defense and DUI/DWI, an honor earned by only 5% of attorneys in Kansas and Missouri.

Scott’s dedication extends to academia. From 2007 to 2013, he taught Trial Advocacy to second and third-year law students at the University of Kansas School of Law. He is also a frequent speaker at continuing legal education (CLE) courses on criminal law and procedure.

Beyond his legal practice, Scott has made significant contributions to his community. He has served as a trustee, strategic planning chair, and alumni leader for The Barstow School in Kansas City, Missouri, his alma mater. Scott has also been involved with the Jayhawks for Higher Education Committee, the Leawood Chamber of Commerce, the Olathe Arts Alliance, and the Olathe Region United Way.

From 1994 to 2001, Scott was the weekly on-air legal analyst for FOX 4 TV in Kansas City, Missouri, beginning with the high-profile O.J. Simpson trial.

Scott resides with his wife and four children in Leawood, Kansas.

attorneys.bio:
The Law Office of Kathleen A. Harvey is located in the greater Kansas City area and serves clients throughout the U.S. Ms. Harvey has focused her practice for the past eight years on offering specialized legal services to the international community and to employers. Her practice ranges from green cards for newly married clients to investor visas to political asylum to naturalization for long term residents. In particular, Ms. Harvey is experienced in appeals and business immigration matters for national and local clients, assisting both professional and non-professional clients obtain temporary visas such as H-1B or in obtaining Permanent Residence through university faculty petitions or through the "labor certification" process. She has a special interest in assisting religious workers with R-1 temporary visas or with Permanent Residence applications. Ms. Harvey's practice has now expanded to include international adoption clients. She welcomes inquiries through e-mail or through telephone consultation, as well as in-person conferences.

attorneys.practice_type: Family Law (divorce, custody, paternity, child support, protection from abuse and stalking) Lawyers in Prairie Village, KS
attorneys.bio:
I am a family law attorney with over 20 years of legal experience, with the majority in divorce, paternity, custody and domestic law. I believe most cases are more successful if the case is resolved via agreement of the parties rather than trial and will use every tool possible to try to get a successful settlement; however, if that isn't possible I have experience with all levels of adversarial hearings including even the most complex custody disputes and divorce trials.

Prior to opening my own firm, I worked for the Johnson County District Attorney's Office as a prosecutor and was a police officer for five years prior to that. I also have experience as a pro tem Judge in civil and criminal courts.

Your case will be a priority with me and you will feel confident that I will be able to present your position in the most positive light possible. I firmly believe in paying attention to detail in all of my cases.

attorneys.name: Courtney T. Henderson
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Overland Park, KS
attorneys.bio:
Courtney T. Henderson, a partner at Henderson Legal Defense, LLC, has practiced criminal defense during his career in courts throughout Kansas and Missouri. He served as an Assistant Deputy Defender for the 10th Judicial District in Johnson County, Kansas prior to co-founding Henderson Legal Defense, LLC. During that time he gained invaluable experience on complex criminal litigation. Mr. Henderson has continued to expand his areas of practice to include juvenile defense, high-profile criminal cases and appeals. Mr. Henderson co-authored a book on Juvenile Defense Strategies published by Aspatore Books. He has also been recognized as one of the Top 40 under 40 trial lawyers in Kansas by The National Trial Lawyers since 2012.

Mr. Henderson has defended clients against allegations involving drugs, weapons, domestic violence, sex offenses and violent crimes in both adult and juvenile courts for several years. His reputation and knowledge resulted in being named a Missouri and Kansas Super Lawyer by Super Lawyers for criminal defense since 2013 and a Top 100 Trial Lawyer by The National Trial Lawyers in 2014, 2015, 2016 & 2017. He was further selected as one of the Nation's Top Attorneys by The National Association of Distinguished Counsel in 2015.

Mr. Henderson is a member on the Board of Directors of the Kansas Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, and continues membership in The National Trial Lawyers, the Johnson County Bar Association and his state bar associations. He serves as a trusted judge pro tem for the 10th Judicial District Court in juvenile and criminal courtrooms. He acts as a mentor attorney in the area of criminal defense in the Kansas City Metropolitan Bar Association and volunteered his legal services for Birthday Blessings KC, a local non-profit organization that provides free birthday services for children in need. He was honored as a Top Lawyer by the Global Directory of Who's Who and maintains a perfect 10.0 rating on AVVO.

Mr. Henderson was born and raised in Kansas on his family farm. He earned his B.S. from Kansas State University in Business Administration as a College of Business Honors Program graduate. He followed by then receiving his J.D. from the University Of Kansas School Of Law in 2003.

attorneys.name: Christopher J. Kellogg Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Overland Park, KS
attorneys.bio:
When facing a divorce or family law matter in the Overland Park, Kansas area, it can be a challenging and difficult time. Not knowing what the future holds for you and your family can be stressful. When these situations arise, it is important that you have dedicated and caring legal counsel in your corner to provide you with guidance and peace of mind throughout the process. Chris Kellogg is a diligent Senior Associate Attorney with Stange Law Firm in our Overland Park office. He can represent clients throughout the Johnson County, KS area, and nearby.

Chris attended Washburn University School of Law in Topeka, Kansas where he earned his Juris Doctor in 2004. While attending law school, he received Dean’s Honors and served as the Student Editor-in-Chief (May 2003-May 2004) and a Student Research Editor (Aug. 2002-May 2003) for the ABA Family Law Quarterly. Before studying law, Chris attended Kansas State University where he earned both a Master of Arts in Spanish Language Acquisition and a Bachelor of Arts in Spanish. Chris is licensed and ready to help clients in the state of Kansas.

Before joining the Overland Park, Kansas divorce and family law attorneys at Stange Law Firm, Chris most recently worked as an attorney for a child support government contractor. In this role, he worked to establish paternity and child support for the Kansas Department for Children and Families in Sedgwick County, Kansas, which included drafting of pleadings and other legal documents for a large caseload, representing DCF in court proceedings, and interacting with internal and external clients. He also worked to modify child support obligations for his clients. Before this, Chris worked in various legal roles over the past 20 years including as an Administrative Law Judge for the State of Kansas Office of Administrative Hearings, a Deputy Director of Child Support Services for the Department for Children and Families in Kansas, and a Staff Attorney for the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit in New York City. Chris is a dedicated family lawyer who takes pride in his legal work. He is focused on helping you navigate the difficult waters of your divorce or family law matter and is eager to help you rebuild your life.

Outside of his legal work, Chris is dedicated to giving back to his community. Throughout his career he has served in various roles for community-based organizations such as the Kansas Child Support Enforcement Association, the Boy Scouts of America, and the Salvation Army and Habitat for Humanity of Salina, Kansas. Chris is also fluent in spoken and written Spanish.

Note: The choice of a lawyer is an important decision and should not be based solely upon advertisements.

attorneys.name: Alicia Edelen Koranda
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Overland Park, KS
attorneys.bio:
When Alicia Koranda first meets with a client her goal is to alleviate any fears they may have by removing the mystery from the process and what they can expect going forward.

"I am able to do this by explaining to my clients how I intend to prepare to build their case toward settlement or trial if it becomes necessary and ensuring they understand what could potentially happen and what is likely to happen in each case," Ms. Koranda said.

It has been her experience that one of the major concerns for clients coming to Cordell & Cordell is the safety and security of their family.

"Most people are really worried about the impact the divorce will have on their children, so I talk to them about how they can set the tone for their divorce," Ms. Koranda said. "I tell them to make sure they are keeping their children as far removed from the divorce proceedings as possible, to always maintain a positive attitude and to let the children know that mom and dad love them no matter what."

Even though there are many pitfalls, both emotional and financial, that each client must face, it is possible to negotiate these challenges successfully, she said.

"As your attorney I will listen to your concerns and assist you in this process to achieve the results that are best for you and your family," Ms. Koranda said. "I will always have your best interest at heart."

attorneys.name: Devin Ledom Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Overland Park, KS
attorneys.bio:
When facing a difficult family law matter such as a divorce or matters involving your children, it is important to have competent representation on your side to ensure that your rights are protected throughout the process. Devin Ledom is a knowledgeable Senior Associate Attorney in Lee's Summit, MO with Stange Law Firm, PC and he is ready to help clients begin the process of putting their life back together.

Devin attended the University of Missouri - Kansas City School of Law where he earned his Juris Doctorate in 1996. Before attending law school, Devin attended the University of Tulsa in Tulsa, Oklahoma where he graduated with honors earning his Bachelor of Arts in Organizational Communication in 1993. Devin is currently licensed to practice law in the state of Missouri and is a member of the Missouri Western District Court of Appeals.

Devin is a seasoned trial attorney with over 25 years of litigation experience. Before joining Stange Law Firm, PC, Devin spent the previous 15 years as an Assistant Prosecuting Attorney in Jackson County, MO. In this role, he served on the Domestic Violence/Special Victims Unit and worked to help prosecute domestic violence crimes, DWI, drug offenses, violent crimes, homicides, child and adult sex crimes. He also handled all special actions including probation violation hearings. Before this, he served on the Family Support Unit where he worked in the criminal child support enforcement division. In this role, he was tasked with reviewing referrals for legal action from the Division of Family Services and determined whether legal action was feasible. He also filed and prosecuted civil contempt actions and criminal charges when necessary, while also maintaining and monitoring a probation caseload that saw him file and prosecute probation violations for defendants who were failing to pay the probation support amount ordered. Prior to this, Devin spent 7 years working as an Assistant Prosecuting Attorney in Camden County, MO where he served as the Project Director for the Camden County Prosecuting Attorney Domestic Crimes Unit, a federally grant funded program through the Violence Against Women's Act and overseen by the Missouri Department of Public Safety. In this role he maintained and oversaw grant paperwork, managed a domestic violence investigator, and served as the primary prosecutor for domestic violence prosecution, while also prosecuting various other felony and misdemeanor cases and probation violations. Devin also spent 3 years working as an Assistant Public Defender for the Missouri State Public Defender's Office where he served as a trial attorney for the Office of the Public Defender in the Trial Division.

When Devin is not busy assisting his clients, he loves spending time with his wife and 2 children. They enjoy playing games, watching the Royals and the Chiefs, and can often be found at the zoo on a nice day. Devin also enjoys golfing and playing fantasy football.

Disclaimer: The choice of a lawyer is an important decision and should not be based solely upon advertisements. Kirk C. Stange and Stange Law Firm, PC are responsible for the content. Principal place of business 120 S. Central Avenue, Suite 450, St. Louis (Clayton), MO 63105.

attorneys.name: Mason D. Lent
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Hutchinson, KS
attorneys.bio:
After interning at Mann Wyatt Tanksley Injury Attorneys in 2013, Mason Lent was inspired to pursue a career as an attorney.

Originally from Wichita, Mason graduated from the University of Kansas in 2013 with a Bachelor of Science in Business. He then attended the University of Kansas School of Law, receiving his Juris Doctor in December 2016.

During law school, Mason spent a summer as a legal intern for the Sedgwick County District Court. Additionally, he was involved in the Douglas County Legal Aid Society where he represented adults and juveniles charged with crimes in Douglas County.

After graduating law school and passing the bar exam, Mason began his career as an attorney at the defense firm of Hite, Fanning & Honeyman, LLP in Wichita. At this firm, his practice focused on insurance defense in the areas of automobile accidents, premises liability and medical malpractice.

Mason joined Mann Wyatt & Tanksley in November 2018 and focuses his practice on personal injury, automobile accidents and workers’ compensation.

He is licensed to practice in Kansas state and federal court, Missouri state and federal court, and Colorado state and federal court. He is a member of the Kansas Bar Association and the Wichita Bar Association.

In his free time, Mason enjoys watching the Kansas Jayhawks compete in basketball. More importantly, Mason is proudly married to his wife, Taylor, and they have four children.

attorneys.name: Scott J. Mann
attorneys.practice_type: Workers' Compensation Lawyers in Hutchinson, KS
attorneys.bio:
Inspired to pursue a career in law after the tragic loss of his father in an airplane accident, Scott J. Mann received his Bachelor of Science in Business Administration from Kansas State University in 1983. He received his Juris Doctor from the University of Kansas Law School in 1986.

Scott began his career at the firm of Gilliland & Hayes, LLC, where he was a partner for 14 years. In 1999, Scott formed Mann Law Offices, LLC, a firm dedicated to pursuing justice for injured victims.

Today, Scott is a seasoned personal injury attorney who uses his skills to help those in need. Just like his family was assisted by a family attorney in their time of difficulty, Scott is the advocate you need to get through the most trying times.

He practices in the areas of workers’ compensation and personal injury, including negligence, wrongful death, automobile and trucking accidents, catastrophic injury, products liability, medical malpractice, nursing home neglect, and premises liability.

Scott is a published author and is licensed in both Kansas state and federal courts. He is a member of the Kansas Bar Association, the Kansas Association for Justice, the Reno County Bar Association, and the Wichita Bar Association.

Scott is a member of the Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forum, a designation reserved for personal injury attorneys who have obtained multi-million dollar settlements or verdicts for their clients.

attorneys.firm_name: Law Office of Teresa M. Meagher
attorneys.practice_type: Social Security Disability Lawyers in Overland Park, KS
attorneys.bio:
Teresa Meagher, with over 35 years of legal experience, practices exclusively in the areas of social security disability, veterans disability, and short term and long term disability claims. She has obtained benefits for many individuals at all levels of appeal from initial applications at the agency level through the appellate court level. Examples of her work at the appellate level are the reported case, Cox v. Apfel, 160 F.3d 1203 (8th Cir. 1998) and the unpublished case, Hinton v. Massanari, No. 00-3408 (10th Circuit, July 3, 2001).

Teresa has presented at several seminars sponsored by the Kansas Bar Association, NOSSCR (Eighth Circuit conference) and the Kansas Trial Lawyers Association on topics related to social security disability law and veterans law.

Prior to beginning her private law practice in 1994, Teresa was employed at Kansas Legal Services, Inc., serving as Project Director of the Wyandotte-Leavenworth office. While working at Legal Services, Teresa represented hundreds of low-income individuals on their claims for public benefits, including social security disability. She was lead counsel in a successful lawsuit against the State of Kansas for failure to provide Medicaid coverage to adults in need of liver transplants.

attorneys.name: Jake Michalski
attorneys.practice_type: Pre-Litigation Lawyers in Topeka, KS
attorneys.bio:
Jake Michalski is a driven attorney who helps individuals navigate the aftermath of serious injuries. Whether handling personal injury or workers’ compensation cases, Jake treats every client as if he were advocating for a close friend or family member. His approach is rooted in empathy, clear communication, and aggressive advocacy aimed at maximizing his clients’ settlements.

Before joining the team at DM Injury Law, Jake represented injured workers in workers’ compensation claims. This experience gave him valuable insight into the physical, emotional, and financial challenges clients face, as well as the strategies insurance companies use to minimize payouts. He draws on this background to analyze each case strategically and thoroughly, ensuring no detail is overlooked.

Jake was born and raised in Topeka, Kansas, and earned both his undergraduate and law degrees from Washburn University, where he also pitched for the baseball team. His passion for injury law took shape during law school internships with personal injury firms in North Kansas City. Outside of work, Jake enjoys spending time with his wife, Gabi, their daughters, Bryce and Scotti, and their two dogs.

attorneys.name: Dan Monnat
attorneys.practice_type: Trial and Appellate Criminal-Defense Lawyers in Wichita, KS
attorneys.bio:
Whether by obtaining a “not guilty” verdict for his white-collar client at the conclusion of the prosecutor’s opening statement, or by obtaining the same result at the conclusion of a three-week shaken-baby, first-degree murder trial, Dan Monnat has long been recognized as a creative trial and appellate criminal-defense lawyer.

For over 45 years Monnat has defended individuals and companies in high-stakes federal and state jury trials, appeals courts, regulatory proceedings, grand jury and other investigations with outstanding results. Twice, Monnat was named Best Lawyers® “Lawyer of the Year” for Wichita, Kansas. In 2012, it was in the category of Criminal Defense-White Collar; in 2014, in the category of Criminal Defense-General Practice. Mr. Monnat has extensive experience and success in complex, lengthy jury trials charging such crimes as conspiracy, criminal bank fraud, money laundering and murder. See Notable Cases. His record of jury trials resulted in his becoming a Fellow in the American College of Trial Lawyers and his high-profile cases have been covered in the New York Times, the Los Angeles Times and featured on CBS 48 Hours.

As well, Mr. Monnat has represented individuals and companies in criminal investigations involving state and federal regulatory agencies including the Kansas Board of Healing Arts, the Kansas Securities Commission, the Kansas Department of Revenue and the federal SEC, DOD, USDA, HHS, OIG, DEA, ATF, ICE, DHS and IRS.

With his years of experience, Mr. Monnat is also frequently in demand to teach other lawyers at national legal conferences and to provide expert news commentary for national broadcasts, appearing on at least NBC’s The Today Show, CNN, CBS Morning News, CBS 48 Hours, Fox News and Court TV.

Dan Monnat has been listed as one of the "Top 10" of Missouri & Kansas Super Lawyers every year from 2018 - 2022, and listed as one of the “Top 100" Missouri & Kansas Super Lawyers for nearly 20 years. He has been listed in Best Lawyers in America® for 36 years.

Dan Monnat co-founded Monnat & Spurrier, Chartered, in 1985. Mr. Monnat is licensed to practice before the United States Supreme Court, the United States Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit, the federal and state courts of Kansas and Nebraska and the federal courts of Colorado, Missouri (W.D) and Michigan (E.D).

attorneys.name: Paul J Morrison
attorneys.practice_type: Administrative Law Lawyers in Olathe, KS
attorneys.bio:
Born in Dodge City, Kansas Paul Morrison is legendary as a "gunfighter" in the courtroom. He has tried nearly 100 jury trials, having lost only twice. A large percentage of those trials were murder cases, although Morrison has tried nearly every type of criminal case, from white collar to traffic. He's an expert and has taught extensively on the law as it relates to search and seizure, police interrogation and other subjects relating to the criminal justice system. He also is a recognized expert in the area of criminal sentencing, having served on the Kansas Sentencing Commission for 18 years.

As a longtime District Attorney in Johnson County, Kansas, nobody knows the inside of a courtroom better than Paul Morrison. Morrison now stands ready to defend those accused of crimes by the government.

Morrison is an expert on many subjects relating to the criminal justice system and has appeared on television news programs such as 60 Minutes, 48 Hours, Nightline, HBO and other national and local news shows too numerous to mention.

In 2006, Morrison was inducted into the American College of Trial Lawyers, a national organization whose membership is limited to the top one percent of trial lawyers in the country.

attorneys.name: RW Mozingo II
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Olathe, KS
attorneys.bio:
Choosing an Attorney is Vital in all Criminal Law or Family Court Cases

Founding attorney RW Mozingo, II has the experience to guide you through any criminal law or family court hurdle you may face in Johnson County, Kansas or in the Kansas City metro area. RW is licensed in the states of Kansas, Missouri, and Minnesota and is available to serve your criminal law and family court needs in the Kansas City Metro area as well as throughout those states. RW has the litigation experience to handle complex criminal law and vigorously fight for your rights. Further, RW is willing to take your case to a trial and even beyond if necessary. RW is a battle-tested trial attorney whose criminal law and family court skills have been proven in the highest courts in the State. He has argued cases before the Kansas Court of Appeals and the Kansas Supreme Court.

RW decided to start his own firm to have a better opportunity to directly help others dealing with criminal law and family court legal problems in Johnson County, Kansas; as well as the Kansas City Metro area. He has the knowledge and compassion to guide you through what can be a very complicated criminal law and family court system. RW understands that the need for criminal law and family court legal representation often occurs during crucial situations and has experience providing support during these stressful times.

Criminal Law Experience

Prior to becoming an attorney, RW graduated from North Carolina State University with bachelor degrees in both Business Management and Sports Management. He worked in the front office for the Carolina Mudcats minor league baseball team prior to being employed as a scientific research technician at NCSU.

RW attended law school at Washburn University in Topeka, Kansas where he graduated with Dean's Honors. While in law school, he was on the Moot Court team as well as trying cases for the Washburn Law Clinic in the family law courts of Shawnee County. He also gained experience while working in the compliance section for the athletic department at Iowa State University.

After graduation, RW worked for the Kansas Attorney General's office in the Criminal Litigation Division before joining the Johnson County District Attorney's Office. He worked at the DA's office for over seven years serving in the traffic, domestic violence and drug sections. RW's skills were acknowledged when he was selected by District Attorney Steve Howe to serve as the Interim Drug Section Chief during his time in the drug unit. Additionally, he has served as Special Prosecutor for the Wyandotte County District Attorney's office. During his last four years as an Assistant District Attorney, RW taught criminal law to law enforcement officers at the Johnson County Police Academy.

RW Mozingo, II - Attorney and Counselor at Law for Johnson County Criminal Law & Family Court Cases

RW has handled a variety of complex criminal law cases and has conducted over 30 jury trials as well as close to 100 bench trials. Those trials have included charges of Murder, Rape, Aggravated Battery, Aggravated Robbery, Aggravated Assault, Domestic Battery, and Driving Under the Influence. RW is an experienced litigator who, in addition to jury trial experiences in District Court, has written appellate briefs and argued before the Kansas Court of Appeals and the Kansas Supreme Court.

Free Consultation

Delay in contacting an attorney may cause consequences that cannot be changed in both criminal law and family court matters. Act quickly and schedule a free consultation with RW Mozingo, II immediately by calling 913-386-4402.
